recognize_zh: 紅箭頭的異常嗜伊紅性前驅細胞內混有大顆、深紫黑色的嗜鹼性顆粒，黑箭頭則是核摺疊、呈單核球樣且有核仁的母細胞；異常嗜伊紅球加上骨髓單核球性母細胞，是 inv(16) AML 的典型組合。
features: Abnormal eosinophil precursor (red arrow) with large, dark purple-black basophilic-staining granules admixed with eosinophilic granules
Blasts (black arrows): large cells with round to folded monocytoid nuclei, fine chromatin, visible nucleoli and moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Additional granulocytic precursor (promyelocyte/myelocyte) with abundant granular cytoplasm
Several eosinophil-lineage cells with distorted nuclei in the upper left
Background red cells and hemodiluted smear
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows blasts with round to folded monocytoid nuclei, fine chromatin, conspicuous nucleoli and moderately basophilic cytoplasm. Abnormal eosinophil precursors are present, one containing large, dark purple basophilic-appearing granules intermixed with eosinophilic granules. Maturing granulocytic precursors are also seen. Findings are consistent with acute myelomonocytic leukemia with abnormal eosinophils, suggestive of AML with inv(16)(p13.1q22)/t(16;16); CBFB::MYH11 should be confirmed by cytogenetics, FISH or RT-PCR.

ddx.vs: Other myelomonocytic leukemias lack the abnormal eosinophils with large basophilic granules; genetics is required to confirm.

t(8;21) blasts have abundant cytoplasm with a salmon-colored perinuclear hof, single long Auer rods and pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules, without monocytoid nuclei and dysplastic basophil-granulated eosinophils.
CMML has <20% blasts and promonocytes with persistent monocytosis and lacks inv(16) eosinophils.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and tyrosine kinase fusion
ddx.vs: These show mature eosinophilia with PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1/JAK2 rearrangement rather than monocytoid blasts with abnormal basophilic eosinophil granules.
